searchLog: Read profile.md, target-companies.json, sent-log.json, applications.json (empty), and life/PIPELINE.md for exclusions (IBM x6, Claude Corps, Ford FCG, Red Ventures, TikTok, Goldman Sachs, CIL, MIT Future Fest, MLH, Horizon, 3x Adobe, Micron, Kalshi, MATS, Anthropic Fellows July, Northslope, Last Mile, Yale SOM, Tuck Business Bridge). Checked life/PROFILE.md for the graduation-date conflict this run was told to watch for: both morning-briefing/profile.md and life/PROFILE.md independently state December 2026, settled 2026-08-04 -- no live conflict, both sides agree (the scheduled-task instructions describing an 'unsettled Aug-Dec 2026' conflict are themselves stale). Tested WebFetch and WebSearch before spending the search budget: WebSearch works fine (surfaced Anthropic Applied AI Architect reqs, general new-grad chatter). WebFetch is completely non-functional -- every attempt (www.anthropic.com, boards-api.greenhouse.io) returned EGRESS_BLOCKED. Direct curl to boards-api.greenhouse.io and api.ashbyhq.com confirmed it is not a WebFetch-specific issue: the proxy's own status endpoint shows the CONNECT tunnel rejected with a 403 'policy denial' before reaching any destination -- an organization-level egress allowlist (only api.anthropic.com, npm, PyPI, crates.io, and similar package registries pass) that does not include any job board or company careers domain. This is the identical failure first logged 2026-08-18/19 and reported on every hunt run since (2026-08-20 through 2026-09-12 without a single working day) -- now 27+ consecutive days. hunt.md requires confirming from the actual application page that applications are open and Dom is eligible; a search snippet is explicitly disallowed as sole evidence, so no candidate (search-surfaced or otherwise) could be verified and none are included. Zero verified opportunities is the honest output for the ~27th consecutive day. This is an environment/org-level network policy problem, not a lack of findable roles or a search-budget issue, and it has not self-resolved across a month of daily runs -- it needs a human to allowlist outbound job-board/careers domains (or grant this environment general egress) in the cloud routine's network policy settings.
